title: Pricing Option
description: A pricing model option offered by a publisher for a product, discriminated by pricing_model. Unit-based models with fixed_price use fixed pricing; unit-based models without fixed_price use auction pricing with optional floor_price and price_guidance. revenue_share is contingent pricing: its payable spend is calculated from settled commissionable_value and does not use fixed_price or bid_price. Bid-based auction models may include max_bid to interpret bid_price as a buyer ceiling instead of an exact honored price.
